annotations.text:
Both flow artboards are live.

Click through: welcome -> choose -> submit or promote -> review -> done. Selecting a listing type, a duration, a bundle or a quantity recomputes the order rail and the total for real -- the pricing logic mirrors buildOrder() in app/work-with-us/config.ts, including the 5,000 / 15,000 tiers and the 4,000 pack rate.

The audience figure is the one deliberate placeholder: copy.ts forbids hard-coded numbers, so it stays [LIVE COUNT] until /work-with-us/api/stats answers.
